name: Fired await delivery recovery mutation probe
command: --mutate 's|export async function reconcileFiredWakeDeliveries.*|export async function reconcileFiredWakeDeliveries(limit = 100): Promise<number> { return 0;|'

--test 'cd packages/operator-core && npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts lib/events/await/store.integration.test.ts -t "recovers a consumed wake after a producer dies before delivery insertion" --reporter=dot'
summary: The focused real-PostgreSQL recovery test passed on the current source. Disabling reconcileFiredWakeDeliveries made its missing-delivery assertion fail, so the probe reported MUTANT CAUGHT. The probe verified byte-for-byte restoration of store.ts.

assertions.evidence: Focused Vitest baseline: 1 passed, 73 skipped, exit 0.
Replacing reconcileFiredWakeDeliveries with an immediate return 0 caused the real-PG test to fail at store.integration.test.ts:385: expected one recovered delivery, received zero. Guard exit 1.
mutation-probe.sh reported verdict=caught, target=in-tree:lock-held, baseline_exit=0, guard_exit=1, and tree integrity VERIFIED for store.ts.
